description: Explicit pinned SHAs for the cross-repository integrity workflow (.github/workflows/cross-repo-integrity.yml). Update deliberately, in the same PR as the change that requires a new pin, never silently.

data-connect.note: Head of PDP-Connect/data-connect main after data-connect#124 merged, captured from main's head and confirmed to BE that head via `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main`, and an ancestor of main via `git merge-base --is-ancestor` — never a PR head. Supersedes e9110014e (data-connect#120). #124 re-vendors data-connect's copies of this repo's codex and claude_code connector sources from data-connectors 56f8443a5, so both sides now carry the complete-rollout-body bytes data-connectors#103 introduced — codex gains artifact-ledger.ts, parsers.ts, schemas.ts and types.ts, and claude_code's artifact-capture.ts moves into the shared src/ tree. Under the previous pin those files were the only mismatch drift job (b) connector-sources reported; at this SHA that job passes with all 31 vendored files across all six connectors byte-identical to canonical. The same pull request adds one line to packages/local-collector/tsconfig.build.json — src/artifact-capture.ts joining the derived shared-module closure that file's own derive-connector-sources test enforces. The six bundled-connector globs drift job (e) collector-packaging-manifest actually compares are untouched, so that job still passes, and packages/local-collector/src/generated/collector-definitions.generated.ts is unchanged in the range, so drift job (a) collector-definitions is unaffected. This is a pin-only change: this repo's #105 deleted drift job (c) tarball-digests and the hand-vendored runtime tarballs it compared, so no repack accompanies the bump. This pin backs THREE drift jobs, none of which involve a packed tarball: (a) collector-definitions, which compares this repo's connector registry against data-connect's committed collector-definitions.generated.ts using packages/local-collector/scripts/generate-collector-definitions-snapshot.ts; (b) connector-sources, which byte-compares the six connector directories data-connect vendors from this repo (claude_code, codex, google_takeout, imessage, apple_photos, google_messages); and (e) collector-packaging-manifest, which compares the registry against packages/local-collector/tsconfig.build.json, the compile list. Those three are source-level comparisons against files committed in data-connect, so they still need an explicit, deliberately-moved SHA — a mutable branch ref would let an upstream change flip them without review. What this pin NO LONGER backs: drift job (c) tarball-digests, retired along with the hand-vendored pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz / pdpp-connector-protocol-0.0.1.tgz. Both packages now install from the npm registry at an exact pinned version, so their provenance is the registry's immutable published artifact plus the lockfile's integrity hash — not a digest list maintained by hand in this repo. The companion `data-connect-1-0-0` pin was deleted in the same change: it existed ONLY to give job (c)'s 1.0.0 leg a second, later data-connect checkout to repack pdpp's 1.0.0 tarballs from, and with job (c) gone it had no remaining reader. packages/collector-runtime and packages/connector-protocol are likewise dropped from the pin-freshness path list for this repo, because npm version resolution — not a path diff against this SHA — is now what governs those two packages.

pdpp.note: Head of PDP-Connect/pdpp main on 2026-09-15, the merge of pdpp#364 'chore(deps): bump the npm-minor-patch group with 14 updates', captured from main's head via `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main` and confirmed an ancestor of main via `git merge-base --is-ancestor` — never a PR head, for the reason the data-connect entry's superseded-pin history above records. Moved from 6f4bf5049 to clear the pin-freshness pdpp leg, which fails on every pull request in this repo once a tracked-path change lands upstream without a repin: that leg diffs the pinned commit against pdpp's tracked ref restricted to packages/reference-contract, and #364 edited packages/reference-contract/package.json — the sole tracked-path change in the range, and the only commit in it, per `git diff --name-only 6f4bf5049 422c27744 -- packages/reference-contract`. The edit is devDependencies-only: @biomejs/biome 2.5.12 to 2.5.13 and ultracite 7.11.0 to 7.11.1, both lint tooling this repo neither installs nor type-checks against. No dependency, export, or source file changed. Drift job (d) reference-contract therefore compares identical bytes before and after: `git log 6f4bf5049..422c27744 -- packages/reference-contract/src` is empty. Verified by running the job's own check-reference-contract-drift.mjs against a clean clone at this SHA — every documented stand-in module matches its canonical pdpp source. pdpp#361 (the prior pin) and #362 between them also deleted pdpp's vendor/ and packages/polyfill-connectors/, but no job in this workflow reads either tree any more: the tarball-digests job that consumed pdpp's vendor/SHA256SUMS is retired, and this repo installs the runtime/protocol packages from the registry. Those deletions need no further change here, and since pdpp will not resurrect either tree, they never will. This is a pin-reference update only: no file in this repository changes besides this entry.
